answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond from a scarce resource before it can submit claims, then slash that bond when independent audits prove a claim fraudulent. A thousand fabricated identities do not create free influence: each must lock capital, and detected fraud destroys some of it. Honest agents can earn the bond back, while attackers face a rising cost as they scale. The saffron, lagoon, and ember communities can each audit claims, making one compromised group insufficient to trigger a penalty.
